requirements.title: NORM2 argument restrictions
requirements.definition: X shall be a real array; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range 1 through the rank of X.

pending.NORM2-X-real-array: Positive source control calls NORM2 with a real rank-one and rank-two array; source-control mutation changes X to an integer array and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.NORM2-DIM-integer-scalar: Positive source control calls NORM2(X,DIM=1) and DIM=2 for a rank-two real array; source-control mutation changes DIM to a noninteger or nonscalar actual and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.NORM2-DIM-valid-rank-range: Positive source control calls DIM=1 and DIM=2 for a rank-two real array; source-control mutations use DIM=0 and DIM=3 and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: NORM2 result type, scalar form, and DIM shape
requirements.definition: The NORM2 result has the same type and type parameters as X; without DIM it is scalar, and with DIM it has rank n-1 and the shape of X with dimension DIM removed.

pending.NORM2-result-same-type-parameters: Use default real and a guarded nondefault real kind selected by SELECTED_REAL_KIND; assert KIND(NORM2(X)) equals KIND(X) and mutate X kind so the check fails.
pending.NORM2-result-scalar-without-DIM: For a rank-two real array initialized with nonzero values, assign NORM2(X) to a scalar result sentinel and assert RANK(NORM2(X)) equals zero; mutate by adding DIM=1 so the rank check fails.
pending.NORM2-result-rank-and-shape-with-DIM: For X shaped [2,3], assert SHAPE(NORM2(X,DIM=1)) equals [3] and SHAPE(NORM2(X,DIM=2)) equals [2]; mutate DIM so the companion shape check fails.

requirements.title: NORM2 DIM result equals whole-array or slice NORM2 values
requirements.definition: With DIM present, rank-one X gives the same value as NORM2(X); otherwise each result element equals NORM2 of the corresponding rank-one slice.

pending.NORM2-DIM-rank-one-equals-whole-array: For a rank-one real vector [3.0,4.0], assert NORM2(V,DIM=1) equals NORM2(V) as an intrinsic-to-intrinsic equality, avoiding an exact decimal norm oracle; mutate by comparing to NORM2(V(1:1)) so the equality fails.
pending.NORM2-DIM-elements-equal-slice-norms: For a rank-two array with nonzero and zero-size-free slices, assert each element of NORM2(X,DIM=1) equals NORM2 of the corresponding column and each element for DIM=2 equals the corresponding row; mutate DIM or a slice subscript so shape/value correspondence fails.
